bar.readOnlyHint: Only the workspace owner or a workspace-wide manager can change these settings.

language.title: Language
language.line: The language used by default across the workspace.
language.label: Default language
language.hint: Used when a user has not chosen a personal language, and for outgoing messages and documents.

currency.title: Currency
currency.line: The base currency for reports and new documents.
currency.label: Default currency
currency.hint: Used as the base currency for reports and new documents. Choose one of your active currencies. Once set, it can be changed but not cleared.
currency.listFailed: Could not load your currencies. Type the code instead or try again.
currency.manualHint: Three letters, for example EGP. It must be one of your active currencies.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.line: Used for reports and scheduled times.
timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: Used for reports and scheduled times, for example Africa/Cairo.
timezone.searchHint: Type part of a city or region name to narrow the list. Up to 50 matches are shown.
timezone.manualHint: Type the IANA name, up to 48 characters, for example Africa/Cairo.

sessionPolicy.title: Session lifetimes

accessTokenTtlSeconds.label: Access token limit
accessTokenTtlSeconds.hint: Maximum lifetime of a newly issued access token, in seconds. The session may end sooner. Allowed range: {{min}} to {{max}} seconds.

idleTimeoutSeconds.label: Idle timeout
idleTimeoutSeconds.hint: Time without activity before the session ends, in seconds. Allowed range: {{min}} to {{max}} seconds.

absoluteTimeoutSeconds.label: Session limit
absoluteTimeoutSeconds.hint: Maximum time from sign-in until the session ends, in seconds, even while active. Allowed range: {{min}} to {{max}} seconds.

sessionPolicy.rememberMeNote: Remember me lets your browser keep you signed in after it closes, within these session limits.
sessionPolicy.rangeError: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} seconds.
sessionPolicy.idleExceedsSession: Idle timeout must not exceed the session limit.

support.title: Support access
support.line: Let the support team help inside this workspace.
support.label: Allow support access
support.hint: Lets the support team help troubleshoot issues in this workspace when needed. You can turn this off anytime.

note.lastWrite: Changes you save replace the current saved values of the fields you edited. If someone else edited the same field in the meantime, their value is overwritten.

states.notReadyTitle: The workspace is still being prepared
states.notReadyLine: Settings appear here once setup finishes. Try again in a moment.
states.forbiddenLine: Ask a workspace administrator to grant you access to view these settings.
states.failedLine: Check your connection and try again.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.text: You have unsaved changes in the workspace settings.
